SCOPE_SUMMARY: Extend the existing constrained AHF Deployment Gateway with fail-closed disk admission, authoritative server-storage classification, bounded builder-cache hygiene, safe historical cleanup, and separate sanitized evidence for application release versus storage hygiene.
NEW_SPEC_JUSTIFICATION: No existing canonical storage-hygiene specification owns the release-integrated server-storage retention contract; the new spec is the single canonical owner rather than a parallel deployment system.
